The most recent Christmas Day I could verify snow falling in England was 25 December 2021, in the Yorkshire Dales. The UK had an official white Christmas in 2023, but that year’s recorded Christmas Day snowfall was all in Scotland. (itv.com)
If you mean widespread snow on the ground, that was Christmas Day 2010. Much of England was already covered in snow. (metoffice.gov.uk)
